response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), station_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), gaps AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average FROM station_shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_minus_average FROM gaps WHERE share_minus_average > 0 ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;
